mapper.select: SELECT item_code FROM consignment_external_supplier UNION SELECT item_code FROM consignment_internal_supplier ORDER BY item_code

SELECT s.id, s.item_code, s.item_name, s.variant, s.hierarchy, s.item_model, s.unit_retail, s.mvc, s.category_l1, s.category_l2, s.category_l3, s.sync_flag, s.deleted_flag, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM consignment_item_setup s
ORDER BY s.item_code ASC LIMIT #{criteria.perPage} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}

SELECT id, item_code, supplier_code, supplier_type, supplier_contract, consignee_company, consignee_store, current_inventory_qty, created_at, updated_at FROM consignment_external_supplier WHERE item_code = #{itemCode} ORDER BY supplier_code, supplier_contract, consignee_company, consignee_store ASC

SELECT id, item_code, supplier_code, supplier_store, consignee_company, consignee_store, created_at FROM consignment_internal_supplier WHERE item_code = #{itemCode} ORDER BY supplier_code, supplier_store, consignee_company, consignee_store ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consignment_external_supplier ( id, item_code, supplier_code, supplier_type, supplier_contract, consignee_company, consignee_store, current_inventory_qty, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{itemCode}, #{supplierCode}, #{supplierType}, #{supplierContract}, #{consigneeCompany}, #{consigneeStore}, #{currentInventoryQty}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE consignment_external_supplier SET supplier_code = #{supplierCode}, supplier_type = #{supplierType}, supplier_contract = #{supplierContract}, consignee_company = #{consigneeCompany}, consignee_store = #{consigneeStore}, current_inventory_qty = #{currentInventoryQty}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE item_code = #{itemCode} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT consignee_company FROM consignment_external_supplier ORDER BY consignee_company ASC

SELECT e.id, e.item_code, s.item_name, s.variant, e.supplier_code, e.supplier_type, e.supplier_contract, e.consignee_company, e.consignee_store, e.current_inventory_qty, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM consignment_external_supplier e LEFT JOIN consignment_item_setup s ON s.item_code = e.item_code AND s.deleted_flag = FALSE WHERE e.consignee_store = #{store} ORDER BY e.item_code ASC
